item.title: Bulletin updated at 00:00 HKT 16/Aug/2023
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
An anticyclone aloft will bring very hot weather to the coast of southern China today. Meanwhile, under the influence of a southwesterly airstream, there will be a few showers over the region. A trough of low pressure is expected to affect the coast of Guangdong in the latter part of this week. There will be more showers with thunderstorms over the region. With the anticyclone aloft strengthening again early next week, the weather will improve and will be hot over the coast of southern China. Besides, Tropical Cyclone Lan will move across the Sea of Japan today and weaken gradually.
